leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a Vue component that accepts and renders children content via slots
Apply slot syntax to pass HTML elements and text as children to components
Configure named slots to organize multiple children content sections
Manipulate slot content using scoped slots to pass data from parent to child
Initialize fallback content within slots to display when no children are provided
Integrate slot props to control how parent content interacts with child component data
Render dynamic children content by binding slot data to component state
